about:
# Mage Tools Forever Broker

Mage Tools status and settings from your LibDataBroker display.

For **World of Warcraft: Forever** (interface 16001).

- Convenient Mage Tools settings access.
- Conjure and tool status where supported by the installed addon.
- Standalone companion for mage broker-bar users.

## Requirements

MageToolsForever

A LibDataBroker display such as Bazooka is needed to show broker controls.

## Controls

Use the Mage Tools Forever broker object.

## Installation

Install through CurseForge or extract the ZIP into your Forever Interface/AddOns folder. Keep the packaged folder name `MageToolsForever_LDB` unchanged; this also preserves existing saved settings. Enable the listed dependencies.

## Publishing

Push a stable annotated version tag matching the TOC, such as `v1.0.1`, to publish. GitHub Actions validates the source and packages a GitHub release; the connected CurseForge native packager handles the CurseForge Release file through its push webhook. No CurseForge publishing token belongs in this repository or its Actions secrets.

## Feedback

[Report an issue](https://github.com/bhuddleston42/MageToolsForeverBroker/issues) with the addon version, expected behavior and Lua error if available.

## Testing

Release packaging and Lua syntax are checked automatically. Included regression tests use simulated game APIs. Real gameplay and combinations of third-party addons can expose additional issues; please report them.
